verdict.rationale: BVNK does offer automations: payment rules created via POST /payment/v1/rules can auto-transfer fiat to crypto. Versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations is therefore a fair question. However, the evidence shows only rule creation. The API version migration guide (Quote API to Transfers v3) is about API versions, not versioning or rolling back a user's automations, so it earns no credit.
